description: Divi5 Toolkit hooks. PostToolUse on Write|Edit runs a deterministic shell script that exits silently unless the edited file has a stylesheet extension (.css/.scss/.sass/.less) AND the project's .claude/divi5-toolkit.local.md sets auto_validate: true. The earlier prompt-type implementation was replaced because LLM-backed hooks narrated their decisions instead of staying silent, blocking non-CSS edits.
